evidence: Lucr. 6.701; Plin. NH 3.88 (Lewis & Short s.v. crātēra: “the aperture of a volcanic mountain, the crater”)
terms.comment: First a mixing bowl; then the mouth of a volcano.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 298.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
